project_summary: A focused SaaS product that helps small teams complete one recurring operational workflow with less manual coordination.

greenfield_context.problem_statement: Small teams coordinate a recurring operational workflow across disconnected tools and lose status, ownership, and decisions.
greenfield_context.primary_outcome: A user can complete and track the core workflow end to end from one interface.
mvp_goals: Deliver one complete workflow from intake to completion
non_goals: No advanced analytics in the first milestone
architecture_assumptions: Start as one deployable web application
Keep business logic outside UI components
technical_constraints: No production credentials in local development
initial_milestones: Scaffold the application and verification gates

important_paths: src/app - planned routes and server entry points
full_gate_command: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
project_rules: Business logic stays outside UI components.
Treat planned architecture as provisional until verified by the scaffold.
do_not_rules: Do not implement later roadmap milestones during the first scaffold.
Do not add dependencies without justification.
